paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得过去一年内某段时间觉得一个计划特别容易，另一段回忆则只留下普通打断后的烦躁，是否同一片刻并不清楚。感受、计划实际可行性和时间未知可以分别保留，不合成为发作或能力证据。例子不要求证明自信、重演情绪或寻找足够鲜明的记忆。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a plan seeming especially easy during a period within the past year. Another recollection contains irritation after an ordinary interruption, with the timing between accounts unclear. Feeling, actual feasibility and unknown timing remain separate without an episode or ability finding. The scene requires no proof of confidence, recreated mood or sufficiently vivid memory.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得与自己平时不同，但哪些经历同时发生并不清楚；部分细节想保留；想问怎样开始谈。”可以只读虚构卡。听者不把高昂当疾病或自信当傲慢，不测试能力、不要求肯定一个临床解释，也不以叙述是否确定决定支持。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a remembered difference from usual, leaves simultaneity unclear, reserves some detail and asks how to begin a conversation. Read only the fictional card. A listener equates no upbeat mood with illness or confidence with arrogance, tests no ability and requires neither a clinical explanation nor a certain account before offering support.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与交流卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，不是MDQ、HCL-32、YMRS、双相筛查、诊断或治疗练习。16条仍保留四组各四条的六类回忆贴切记录，不测频率、天数、发作、严重度或能力，未计分与不符分开、不补零。过去一年内同一自选回忆时段是编辑参照，不核实同时发生、时长或临床发作，也不是求助等待期。四个可重叠主题不是验证独立维度；原创观察尚无独立验证、常模或中英文测量等值。任何组合不认证睡眠足够、决定安全或排除疾病，不授权改药、取消支持或推迟评估。已有能量流动、注意力能量、PTQ与执行功能题本保留自己的契约，不转移回答或合并数字。四篇全文与原有支持说明无需作答；复制仅含公开标题与入口，不含类别、日期、时段、事件、消息、账户或健康资料。
paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not MDQ, HCL-32, YMRS, bipolar screening, diagnosis or treatment exercises. Sixteen descriptions retain four groups of four with six recollection-match categories, not frequency, days, episodes, severity or ability. Unscored stays distinct from does not match and is not zero. One optional remembered period within the past year is an editorial reference, verifying neither simultaneity, duration nor a clinical episode, and requiring no wait for support. Four overlapping topics are not validated independent dimensions. The original observations lack independent validation, norms or established English–Chinese measurement equivalence. No pattern certifies sufficient sleep, safe decisions or absence of illness, or authorises changed medicine, cancelled support or postponed assessment. Existing Energy Flow, Attention and Energy, PTQ and executive-function forms retain separate contracts without transferred answers or combined numbers. All four guides and existing support information need no answers. Copying contains only the public title and entry, without categories, dates, periods, events, messages, accounts or health information.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得那段时间睡得较少、开始了更多活动，却不清楚可用休息时间或后来怎样；另一个人只记得转去做别的事。同一主题可以容纳不同未知，不能认证睡眠需求变少、活动有益或经历属于轻躁狂。例子不要求看设备、核对时长、少睡或增加任务。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls less sleep and more activity starts during that period without knowing available rest or what followed. Another reader recalls only moving to another activity. One topic can retain different unknowns without certifying reduced sleep need, beneficial activity or hypomania. The scene requires no device check, verified duration, reduced sleep or added tasks.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想谈记得的睡眠或活动变化，不先判断原因；时长和其他细节可能说不清。”可以只读，不提供作息表。听者不把没记得累当成休息足够，不安排精力测试、运动或熬夜，也不因某类计数少而提供安全放行；已有专业意见保持独立。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names remembered sleep or activity change without choosing a cause and allows uncertain duration or detail. Reading needs no timetable. A listener infers no sufficient rest from unremembered tiredness, assigns no energy test, exercise or wakefulness and offers no safety clearance from sparse categories. Existing professional advice remains independent.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得独处时几个想法挤在一起，却不记得说话变化；另一段回忆只留下熟悉谈话中说得更多，对方感受未知。想法、说话与他人反应是不同信息，不补成同一事件、实测速度或社交能力。例子不要求回放录音、重开消息、压制想法或联系听者。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls crowded ideas while alone without a remembered speaking change. Another account contains more speech in a familiar conversation, with the listener’s experience unknown. Thought, speech and others’ responses remain different information without one event, measured speed or social ability being inferred. The scene requires no replayed recording, reopened message, suppressed thought or contacted listener.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我记得自己的节奏与平时不同，不清楚别人怎样接收，也不想重述私下谈话。”可以只谈虚构例子。听者不认证聪明、打断或被误解，不要求慢下来才值得被听见；可以先问专业谈话怎样组织，不提供实录、不重演说话方式。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card names a remembered change in personal pace without knowing others’ reception or retelling a private exchange. Discuss only the fictional example. A listener certifies no intelligence, interruption or misunderstanding and requires no slower speech to deserve attention. Discussion can begin with how a professional conversation works, without a transcript or reenacted speaking style.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得较快接下一项普通承诺，却不清楚当时可选条件；另一次改变计划还涉及新的期限。速度、条件与结果可以分开，不由结果顺利证明安全，也不由后果困难证明疾病。例子不要求提供账户、再做购买、测试克制或重新作出决定。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls accepting an ordinary commitment more quickly without knowing the available alternatives. Another changed plan involves a new deadline. Speed, conditions and outcomes remain separate without a favourable outcome proving safety or a difficult one proving illness. The scene requires no account records, new purchase, restraint test or repeated decision.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我想理解记得的决定方式差别；不想展示金额、承诺或相关人信息；下一步先问谈话流程。”可以只读。听者不作财务或医疗许可，不评价品格或决策资格，也不替本人改动计划；合适支持不等待证明后果或接受发作标签。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card asks about a remembered difference in deciding while reserving amounts, commitments and people involved, starting with the conversation process. Reading alone is enough. A listener gives no financial or medical clearance, judges no character or decision-making capacity and changes no plan for the person. Appropriate support waits for neither demonstrated consequences nor an episode label.
